svg.aria-label: Tessra, Git for your agents: agents work in parallel in their own workspaces on units of the same file, a standard decides what lands, trunk exports to git, and memory lives in the repository
svg.text: The version control system for the era of AI.
each in its own workspace, on different units of the same file
verifiers run by the daemon, results signed
one commit per landing; teammates keep using git
gotchas, decisions, and conventions, scoped to the code they describe, recalled by every agent on any machine, and shared with anyone who joins
Rust · MIT · CLI + MCP · runs beside .git
